entries.source: An unforgettable river adventure through Köprülü Canyon National Park.
entries.translation: An unforgettable river adventure through Köprülü Canyon National Park.

entries.source: Experience 14 kilometres of rafting on the Köprüçay River, surrounded by dramatic canyon scenery, pine forests, ancient Roman bridges and crystal-clear mountain water.
entries.translation: Experience 14 kilometres of rafting on the Köprüçay River, surrounded by dramatic canyon scenery, pine forests, ancient Roman bridges and crystal-clear mountain water.

entries.source: Rafting in Köprülü Canyon is one of Turkey’s most popular outdoor adventures, combining mountain scenery, fresh air and an exciting river route.
entries.translation: Rafting in Köprülü Canyon is one of Turkey’s most popular outdoor adventures, combining mountain scenery, fresh air and an exciting river route.

entries.source: The experience takes place on the Köprüçay River inside Köprülü Canyon National Park. The rafting route covers approximately 14 kilometres through pine forests, rocky canyon walls and clear mountain water.
entries.translation: The experience takes place on the Köprüçay River inside Köprülü Canyon National Park. The rafting route covers approximately 14 kilometres through pine forests, rocky canyon walls and clear mountain water.

entries.source: Along the way, you will pass sections of lively rapids, enjoy swimming breaks and see the region’s famous ancient Roman bridges.
entries.translation: Along the way, you will pass sections of lively rapids, enjoy swimming breaks and see the region’s famous ancient Roman bridges.

entries.source: Before entering the river, professional instructors provide a full safety briefing. All essential rafting equipment is supplied, and experienced guides accompany the group throughout the route.
entries.translation: Before entering the river, professional instructors provide a full safety briefing. All essential rafting equipment is supplied, and experienced guides accompany the group throughout the route.
